llmmetric: Psychometric Validation and Inference for LLM-Coded Data

Source: R/llmmetric-package.R
llmmetric-package.Rd

Treats large language models (LLMs) explicitly as fallible psychometric measurement instruments. Provides multi-facet structured coding orchestration with resumable checkpointing and hardened caching, Generalizability Theory (G-study and D-study), calibration against human gold standards and inter-rater reliability ceilings, temporal drift monitoring, Differential Prompt Functioning (DPF) invariance tests, Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI, PPI++, Horvitz-Thompson IPW-PPI, cross-fitted non-linear calibration, prevalence proportions, and clustered/multilevel extensions), stratified validation sampling, validation sample-size/power planning, APA reporting tables, and publication-ready ggplot2::autoplot() diagnostics.

See also

Key workflow entry points:

  • Multi-facet coding: coding_schema(), coding_design(), code_texts(), coding_cache(), backend_openai(), backend_ollama(), backend_custom(), backend_mock()

  • Psychometrics & fairness: g_study(), d_study(), calibration_metrics(), human_irr(), check_drift(), dpf_test()

  • Error-corrected inference & planning: select_validation_sample(), ppi_mean(), ppi_proportion(), ppi_lm(), ppi_glm(), ppi_calibrated(), ppi_clustered(), ppi_lmer(), ppi_sample_size(), ppi_power(), format_apa_table()
